ครัวบ้านไม้ไทย (Rustic Thai wooden-house kitchen): A semi-open kitchen viewed from a standing position facing a corner, lit by daylight through wooden lattice walls and one bare hanging bulb at top left. The roof is corrugated metal on dark wooden beams. Left wall: brown wooden planks with two shelves holding about four aluminium pots and pans. Back wall: diagonal wooden lattice with roughly twelve aluminium pots and pans hanging in two rows (exact count unclear) and a large wok hanging at centre-right. Floor, left to right: a white plastic jug, a blue lidded bucket, a dark ceramic jar, and a stainless-steel two-burner gas stove on the floor. Centre: a three-tier light wooden shelf unit holding bowls, jars, a tray of eggs, and many bottles of sauces and oil; a dark cloth hangs behind it. Right of it: a green gas cylinder. Right wall: two dark wooden shelves stacked with large aluminium steamer pots, bowls and pot lids. Front right: a clear plastic storage box with a white lid. Floor: terracotta-orange tiles in a parquet pattern. A door opening with greenery is at the far left edge.
